_comment: Copy this file, fill every field for the target client, pass the path to scripts/generate_deck.js. Fields marked illustrative-ok can stay as round numbers if the person has no real platform counts, but keep them clearly labeled as illustrative in any client-facing copy that references them.
primary_pain: increasing integration and operating costs as they add applications, cloud infrastructure, and data systems
primary_outcome: simplify their technology environment, improve visibility, and reduce avoidable expenditure
seo_search_query: best healthcare data-intelligence platforms in the US

target_account_example._note: Only set real_name if the person explicitly supplied a real target company. Otherwise leave null and use_generic:true.

_include_event_slide_note: On by default. Adds an 11th section: Event & Webinar Attendee Acceleration (invite mockup + house-list vs. ICP-matched RSVP comparison). Set false to go back to the original 10-section deck.

event._format_options: webinar | plant-tour lunch | executive roundtable lunch
event.title: Cutting Integration Costs in Digital Healthcare — Executive Roundtable
